instruction.name: xvfmsub.s
instruction.description: Compute packed single precision floating point FMA(Fused Multiply-Add): multiply elements in `a` and `b`, subtract elements in `c` and store the result in `dst`.

experiments.init: li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 0x3f800000; xvreplgr2vr.w $xr3, $r4

notes: LBT-free LASX/LSX fused multiply-add. vd is write-only: it is not read as an accumulator (a vd -> vd chain runs at about 0.5 cycles). The vj, vk, and va paths each cost 5 cycles.
